description: The figure presents a donut chart illustrating the distribution of deception outcomes across two ambiguity conditions, labeled "Ambiguity 1 (Outer)" and "Ambiguity 2 (Inner)", with a corresponding legend for each. The chart is composed of three colored segments—red for "Deceived", yellow for "Partially", and green for "Not Deceived"—which are displayed in both the outer and inner rings. The outer ring, representing Ambiguity 1, shows a red segment (Deceived) at 67.6% and a yellow segment (Partially) at 57.9%. The inner ring, representing Ambiguity 2, displays a red segment (Deceived) at 23.5%, a yellow segment (Partially) at 10.5%, and a green segment (Not Deceived) at 8.8%. The percentages are explicitly labeled on the chart, with the outer ring's segments appearing larger than those in the inner ring.
